name: Boundary Path Integral Formulation
aliases: Boundary Path Integral Formulation for Differentiable Rendering
definition: A formulation for differentiable rendering of translucent objects with respect to their shapes that reparameterizes interior components of differential path integrals as a new class of boundary path integrals, eliminating the need to specify change rates in the interior of objects.
summary: Boundary Path Integral Formulation estimates shape gradients in differentiable volume rendering by converting interior integrals to boundary area integrals, avoiding expensive tetrahedralizations.
